output.objection: I will not sign off on automating KPI definitions without my direct manual review of every security and compliance impact. This proposal fails to meet our non-negotiable governance standards.
output.correction: I am not saying we cannot track metrics, I am saying the definition logic itself must stay under human architectural control. Do not confuse my stance on process automation with a rejection of data visibility.
